Query: Can I put the Robin's Call Mug in the dishwasher?
Response: Hi there, I'd recommend hand washing your Robin's Call Mug rather than putting it in the dishwasher. Because it's made from earthenware, which is fired at lower temperatures than stoneware or porcelain, it's more porous and can absorb water and detergents over time, which weakens the piece and can cause crazing or cracking. The hand-painted robin silhouette is delicate too, so it deserves a gentle touch. To care for it, I suggest washing by hand in warm water with mild soap and drying it right away with a soft cloth, never letting it soak. With proper care, your mug will develop a beautiful patina over time and continue to bring that morning birdsong feeling to your hands for years to come. Warmly, Olivia Babu
